question: Does env_seed 0 versus 1 change policy-visible inputs after the corrected evaluator seed order and fixed official init state?
measurements: raw reset images and state plus qpos/qvel before set_init_state
query0 and post-eight-step raw views, resized views, normalized proprio, processor BF16 pixel_values, input_ids, attention_mask
within-seed repeat differences and cross-seed differences

admission_gate.same_seed_repeat: exact or below preregistered render noise
admission_gate.policy_visible_difference: at least 8 of 10 tasks at query0 beyond repeat noise, reproducible after eight no-op steps
admission_gate.task_validity: no pre-solved state, early done, or simulation error

if_no_policy_visible_difference: Do not run C0/C3 under env_seed 1 as a new condition. Use pre-init reset hashes to determine whether fixed init state erased changes, then preregister a separate valid reset-condition smoke.
if_gate_passes: Preregister and run a frozen C0/C3 ten-pair micro on the same task/reset set; report rescue and break without task selection.
